description: This is a test class for the EmailService in the OrangeHRM application, specifically testing email-related functionalities such as configuration retrieval, sending test emails, and utility setup. It contains unit tests that mock dependencies and verify behaviors of the EmailService class.

classes.name: EmailServiceTest
